title: Egg Almond Banana Snack Bowl
description: Boiled eggs with crushed almonds and sliced banana — a quick, protein-rich vegetarian snack for between-meal refuelling.
instructions: Boil eggs for 10 minutes, cool under running water, peel and halve.
Slice banana into rounds.
Arrange eggs, banana and almonds in a bowl and serve.

title: Greek Yogurt Oat Almond Snack Bowl
description: Thick Greek yogurt stirred through rolled oats and topped with crushed almonds and banana — a filling mid-calorie snack delivering 35g+ protein.
instructions: Spoon Greek yogurt into a bowl.
Stir in rolled oats until fully combined.
Scatter crushed almonds on top.
Add sliced banana and serve chilled.

title: Paneer Oat Chia Power Snack
description: Crumbled paneer mixed with cooked oats, chia seeds and banana — a calorie-dense vegetarian snack for larger athletes and hard gainers.
instructions: Cook oats in water until thick, about 5-7 minutes.
Stir in crumbled paneer and chia seeds while oats are warm.
Top with sliced banana and serve immediately.

title: Tuna Avocado Quinoa Snack Bowl
description: Flaked tuna over fluffy quinoa with creamy avocado — a high-calorie non-vegetarian snack ideal for large muscle-gain users on 3-meal plans.
instructions: Cook quinoa in water (1:2 ratio) for 15 minutes until water is absorbed. Fluff with a fork and cool slightly.
Drain and flake tuna over quinoa.
Slice avocado and arrange alongside.
Season with salt and pepper and serve.

title: Chicken Almond Yogurt Power Bowl
description: Grilled chicken breast with Greek yogurt, almonds and banana — an ultra-high-calorie protein snack (970 kcal, 99g protein) designed for 100+ kg bodybuilders on 3-meal plans.
instructions: Season chicken breast with salt and pepper. Pan-fry in a non-stick pan for 6-7 minutes each side until cooked through.
Slice chicken and place in a bowl alongside Greek yogurt.
Add almonds and sliced banana.
Mix and serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Oat Egg Spinach Scramble
description: Rolled oats folded into scrambled eggs with wilted spinach — a lighter, protein-balanced breakfast for smaller users or fat-loss goals.
instructions: Cook oats in water until half-done, about 3 minutes, then set aside.
Heat olive oil in a pan. Add spinach and wilt for 2 minutes.
Whisk eggs and pour over spinach. Add the partially-cooked oats and scramble together until set.
Season with salt and pepper and serve warm.

title: Paneer Oat Honey Breakfast Bowl
description: Crumbled paneer stirred through warm oats and topped with banana and a honey drizzle — a mid-calorie vegetarian breakfast for average users.
instructions: Cook oats in water for 5-7 minutes until creamy.
Crumble paneer into the warm oats and stir well.
Transfer to a bowl, top with sliced banana and a drizzle of honey.
Serve warm.

title: Salmon Avocado Egg Breakfast Bowl
description: Baked salmon served with soft-scrambled eggs and creamy avocado — a high-fat, high-protein non-vegetarian breakfast for medium-large users.
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C. Season salmon with salt, drizzle with olive oil and bake for 12-15 minutes until flaky.
Whisk eggs and scramble in the remaining olive oil in a pan for 3-4 minutes.
Slice avocado. Plate salmon, scrambled eggs and avocado together and serve.

title: Soy Chunk Oat Smoothie Breakfast Bowl
description: Rehydrated soy chunks blended through warm oats with banana and honey — a vegan, calorie-dense breakfast delivering 70g protein for large athletes.
instructions: Soak soy chunks in boiling water for 10 minutes. Drain and squeeze out excess water.
Cook oats in water for 5-7 minutes until thick.
Stir rehydrated soy chunks into the oats and mix well.
Top with sliced banana and a drizzle of honey. Serve warm.

title: Chicken Egg Oat Power Breakfast
description: Ground chicken mixed with eggs and oats into a protein-packed savoury bowl — an ultra-high-calorie breakfast for 100+ kg bodybuilders needing 1000+ kcal per meal.
instructions: Cook oats in water for 5 minutes until thick. Set aside.
Mince or chop chicken breast finely. Cook in olive oil over medium heat for 8-10 minutes until cooked through.
Whisk eggs and pour over chicken in the pan. Scramble together for 3-4 minutes.
Stir in cooked oats, top with sliced banana and serve hot.

title: Lentil Spinach Power Soup
description: Green lentils simmered with spinach and tomato — a filling, high-fibre vegan lunch option for fat-loss or smaller users.
instructions: Rinse lentils and place in a pot with 400ml water. Bring to a boil and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add chopped tomato and spinach and cook for another 5 minutes.
Drizzle olive oil, season with salt and serve hot.

title: Chickpea Quinoa Buddha Bowl
description: Spiced chickpeas over fluffy quinoa with baby spinach — a balanced, calorie-moderate vegan lunch.
instructions: Cook quinoa in water (1:2 ratio) for 15 minutes until fluffy.
Drain and rinse chickpeas. Heat olive oil in a pan and cook chickpeas with salt and pepper for 5 minutes.
Wilt spinach in the pan for 1 minute.
Serve chickpeas and spinach over quinoa.

title: Chicken Breast Quinoa and Greens Bowl
description: Grilled chicken breast over a bed of quinoa with wilted spinach — a lean, high-protein non-vegetarian lunch for medium-large users.
instructions: Cook quinoa in water (1:2 ratio) for 15 minutes. Set aside.
Season chicken breast with salt and pepper. Grill or pan-fry in olive oil for 6-7 minutes per side until cooked through. Slice.
Wilt spinach in the same pan for 1-2 minutes.
Plate quinoa, top with chicken slices and spinach. Serve.

title: Salmon Brown Rice Power Bowl
description: Baked salmon over brown rice with wilted spinach — a calorie-rich non-vegetarian lunch for large users with high energy demands.
instructions: Cook brown rice in water (1:2 ratio) for 20 minutes. Set aside.
Season salmon with salt, pepper and olive oil. Bake at 200°C for 15 minutes until flaky.
Wilt spinach in a pan for 2 minutes.
Plate rice, top with salmon and spinach. Serve.

title: Soy Chunk Kidney Bean Rice Bowl
description: Rehydrated soy chunks and kidney beans over brown rice — a plant-based powerhouse delivering 95g protein and 1375 kcal, designed for vegan bodybuilders and hard gainers.
instructions: Soak soy chunks in boiling water for 10 minutes, drain and squeeze dry.
Cook brown rice in water (1:2) for 20 minutes.
Heat olive oil in a pan. Add soy chunks and kidney beans, season and cook for 10 minutes.
Serve over brown rice.

title: Red Lentil Tomato Spinach Soup
description: Red lentils simmered with tomato and spinach — a light, high-fibre vegan dinner for fat-loss or smaller users needing 500 kcal meals.
instructions: Rinse red lentils and place in a pot with 400ml water. Bring to boil and simmer for 15 minutes until soft.
Add chopped tomato and spinach, cook 5 more minutes.
Drizzle olive oil, season with salt and serve hot.

title: Paneer Quinoa Masala
description: Pan-fried paneer cubes in a light masala sauce served over quinoa — a protein-rich vegetarian dinner for average users.
instructions: Cook quinoa in water (1:2) for 15 minutes. Fluff and set aside.
Cut paneer into cubes and pan-fry in olive oil for 3-4 minutes until golden.
Add chopped spinach and tomato to the pan, cook 4 minutes.
Serve paneer masala over quinoa.

title: Grilled Chicken Sweet Potato Quinoa Bowl
description: Grilled chicken breast with baked sweet potato and quinoa — a balanced, calorie-rich non-vegetarian dinner for medium-large users.
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C. Cube sweet potato, toss with half the olive oil, and roast for 25 minutes.
Season chicken with salt and pepper. Pan-fry in remaining olive oil for 6-7 minutes per side. Slice.
Cook quinoa in water (1:2) for 15 minutes.
Bowl up quinoa, top with chicken slices and roasted sweet potato.

title: Shrimp Quinoa Spinach Power Bowl
description: Pan-seared shrimp over quinoa with spinach — a very high-protein non-vegetarian dinner for large users (81g protein, 966 kcal).
instructions: Cook quinoa in water (1:2) for 15 minutes. Fluff and set aside.
Heat olive oil in a pan over high heat. Add shrimp and cook 2-3 minutes per side until pink and cooked through.
Add spinach to the pan and wilt for 1 minute.
Serve shrimp and spinach over quinoa.

title: Chicken Soy Chunk Brown Rice Dinner Bowl
description: Chicken breast and soy chunks over brown rice — an extreme-calorie non-vegetarian dinner (1460 kcal, 123g protein) engineered for 100+ kg bodybuilders on 3-meal plans.
instructions: Soak soy chunks in boiling water for 10 minutes, drain and squeeze dry.
Cook brown rice in water (1:2) for 20 minutes.
Season chicken breast, pan-fry in olive oil for 6-7 minutes per side. Slice.
In the same pan add soy chunks and cook for 5 minutes. Combine chicken, soy chunks and rice in a bowl and serve.
